details: Bitcoin's price has fallen below $81,000, reaching a low near $80,250 on October 17, 2026. This dip is influenced by U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs recording $409.2 million in net outflows between October 12-16, with $82.39 million withdrawn on October 16 alone. Additionally, rising geopolitical tensions, specifically concerns over potential conflict between the U.S. and Iran, are adding to market pressure and contributing to a broader cryptocurrency market contraction of 2.20% in the last 24 hours.
title: Bitcoin Dips Below $81K Amid ETF Outflows & Geopolitical Risk

details: Ethereum's price has experienced volatility, briefly dropping below 2,400 USDT on both October 16 and 17, 2026, marking a 2.26% decrease in 24 hours. U.S. spot Ethereum ETFs have seen significant net daily redemptions, ranging from over $60 million to $129 million, contributing to increased selling pressure. Macroeconomic factors such as hawkish Federal Reserve policies, rising U.S. Treasury yields, and higher-than-expected U.S. CPI inflation data are also impacting ETH's performance.
title: Ethereum Faces Pressure, Briefly Drops Below $2,400 with ETF Outflows

details: Deutsche Bank is preparing to launch Bitcoin and Ethereum custody services in Germany for institutional clients within weeks. The German banking giant plans to expand these digital asset services into Asian financial centers in 2027. This strategic move is part of Deutsche Bank's broader objective to achieve an 8% compound annual growth in its corporate banking sector by 2028, signaling a deeper integration of traditional finance with the crypto market.
title: Deutsche Bank Set to Launch Bitcoin & Ethereum Custody Services
